about_the_game:
Cavernreach is a first-person exploration adventure that drops you into the heart of a vast, interconnected cave system.
No combat. No enemies. Just you, your instincts, and the echoing silence of ancient stone.

Navigate winding tunnels, towering chambers, and forgotten passageways in search of the cave’s second entrance—or a way out.
Every corner of the world is handcrafted, offering a grounded and atmospheric journey inspired by real-world caving and the thrill of the unknown.

There’s no map. No guides. Only the rock, your flashlight, and your own sense of direction.

🪨 Features

  • Immersive Exploration – Traverse a large, seamless cave system filled with chambers, tunnels, squeezes, and vertical drops.

  • Moody Ambience – Let the atmospheric soundscape and original music draw you into the isolation—and beauty—of underground exploration.

  • Handcrafted World – Built with care and detail by a solo developer passionate about adventure and discovery.

  • No Hand-Holding – You won’t be led—only encouraged to keep going.

  • Full-Fledged Caving – Climb ropes, crawl through tight spaces, and even scuba dive in flooded sections of the cave.

  • Equipment Management – Use your flashlight, climbing gear, glowsticks, and scuba equipment to survive.
    Your battery won’t last forever—no light, no life. Glowsticks help you mark your way.
    The same goes for your air supply while cave diving. Run out, and you won’t be coming back.

Find the exit—if one exists.

👤 A Note from the Developer

Cavernreach is a solo-developed project inspired by a love for exploration, adventure, and time spent outdoors with my young daughter.
We love hiking, kayaking, and even some basic caving together—and this game was my way of bringing that joy to life.

While it’s priced affordably, this isn’t a cheap cash grab.
It’s not AAA, and it doesn’t try to be. I kept the scope small and focused to make sure everything works well and gives players something real—no broken promises, no half-finished systems. 99% of the game models are custom made and textured by me. No asset flips or lazy ways out.

You’ll explore, gather resources, upgrade your gear, and venture deeper into a cave system inspired by the real thing.

I hope you enjoy it. I made it with a lot of heart.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 @ 2.4GHz+ / Intel equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX series graphics card / Radeon equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
